evidence.text: The car record and its consumer
the original at 0x136cc holds 277 bytes and 87 instructions up to the early ret at 0x137e0; the full body continues to the ret at 0x142ea, so the store keeps the 3104-byte extent and sets no size

the six callers at 0x12c83, 0x12d2c, 0x12e2e, 0x12f2a, 0x130fa, and 0x13181 pass the player object at object-3 offset 0xf91c and a load flag; the function copies the selected 0x40-byte CARS_DATA record from 0xd25c + DAT_0011d2a0 * 0x40 to +0x470, uses the string at +0x474, four bytes into the file name, so AUTO00 gives 00, reads the animation flag at +0x47c, builds COCK%s%c with A or B, loads the cockpit through 0x1b23c, reads the CARS list through 0x15460, and loads the SHADOW object at +0x468 and the animation object at +0x460 through 0x11060; the data at object-3 offset 0x5a5 holds the timer format %02d:%02d:%02d, so the module names the function player_car_init
the rebuild covers the 87-instruction prefix; the zero load flag returns 0 and the success path returns 0 after the two object loads; the state reset after 0x13dcf is not in the module

name: player_car_init
role: loads the selected car record into the player car object: copies the 0x40-byte record, builds the cockpit names, loads the cockpit resource and the cars list, and loads the shadow and animation objects
